item.name: Appointments
item.description:
Endpoints for managing patient appointments, scheduling, and appointment status.
Includes queue management and appointment tracking features.

request.description:
Retrieve a list of appointments with optional filtering by branch, date, or status.
Returns complete appointment details including patient, doctor, and branch information.

Schedule a new appointment for a patient. Automatically generates a unique token number
and sets initial status to "Scheduled".
Update an existing appointment's details. Can update any field except the ID.
Permanently cancel and remove an appointment from the system.

Update only the status of an appointment. Useful for queue management
(e.g., moving from "Scheduled" to "Waiting" to "Completed").

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
Endpoints for user authentication and profile management in the Dental Management System.
This API handles user login with token-based authentication and retrieval of profile data.

request.description: Authenticate a user using email and password and return an access token with role, permissions, and branch info.

Revoke the current access token to log the user out.
Requires Bearer token authentication.

Get the authenticated user's information using their token.
Requires Bearer token authentication.

Retrieve comprehensive profile information for the authenticated user including:
- Employee details with branch name and permissions
- Attendance statistics
- Appointment statistics
- Payroll history
- Recent appointments

Requires Bearer token authentication.

item.name: Invoices & Billing
item.description:
Endpoints for managing patient invoices, payments, and billing operations.
Includes invoice creation, payment processing, and financial tracking.

request.description:
Retrieve a list of invoices with optional filtering by branch or status.
Returns complete invoice details including treatments, charges, and payment transactions.

Create a new invoice for a patient with treatments and optional additional charges.
Automatically sets initial status to "Pending" and paid amount to 0.

Retrieve detailed information for a specific invoice including all treatments,
additional charges, and payment history.

Update an existing invoice's details. Can update basic information but not treatments or charges.
For adding treatments or charges, create a new invoice instead.

Permanently delete an invoice and all associated treatments, charges, and transactions.
Use with caution as this action cannot be undone.

Process a payment for an invoice. Creates a payment transaction and updates
the invoice's paid amount and status automatically.
If paid amount reaches or exceeds total amount, status changes to "Paid".

Retrieve lab orders.

item.name: Patients
item.description:
Endpoints for managing patient records, dental charting, and treatment planning.
Includes comprehensive dental record management with odontogram support.

request.description:
Retrieve a list of all patients with their complete dental records.
Can be filtered by branch ID.

Create a new patient record with basic information.
Automatically sets default occlusal records and status.

Retrieve detailed information for a specific patient including all dental records,
treatment plans, images, and specialized records.
Update an existing patient's information.
Permanently delete a patient record and all associated data.
Add a new image to patient's records (X-rays, clinical photos, etc.).

Update or create a dental record for a specific tooth (odontogram update).
This is the primary endpoint for dental charting/odontogram updates.

Save or update periodontal records for multiple teeth.
Replaces all existing periodontal records for the patient.
Update the patient's occlusal analysis record.
Create a new treatment plan for a patient.
Record soft tissue examination findings.
Record orthodontic treatment progress or consultation.

item.name: Roles & Permissions Management
item.description:
Endpoints for managing user roles and permissions in the Dental Management System.
Super Admin access required for most operations.

request.description:
Retrieve a comprehensive list of all defined roles and their assigned permissions.
Intended for the 'Roles & Permissions' settings page.

variable.description: The ID of the role to update.

request.description:
Update the permissions for a specific role. The provided permissions array
will completely replace the existing permissions for that role.

variable.description: The ID of the role to retrieve.

request.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific role including all permissions.

Retrieve a lightweight list of all roles containing only their ID and name.
Useful for populating UI dropdowns when creating or editing employees.
